evidence_search.notes: Current screen reads the repository-preserved source-attributed evidence and complete episode inventory. It does not claim fresh full-text access to every originating source. No canonical restamp or independent source verification is implied.

episode_inventory.purpose: Preserve the provider-confirmed safety-control sequence and separate successful control activation from legally contested referral decisions and unresolved model-output allegations.

clauses.source_paraphrase: OpenAI says automated systems detected violent-policy activity on the account in June2025.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Detection is distinct from human adjudication.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The detected account was routed to human reviewers to assess policy violations and possible referral.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A valid detection trigger led to operative review.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The provider reports a detected violent-policy trigger routed to human review, demonstrating activation of that bounded review control.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The first account was banned in June2025 for policy violations.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Account-level restriction is a bounded protective effect, not whole-event prevention.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Human review produced an operative first-account ban for policy violations; this activation is distinct from the disputed referral decision.
The account ban concretely restricted the detected account. This is the reported account-level protective effect, not proof of whole-event prevention or repeat-account detection.

clauses.source_paraphrase: OpenAI did not refer the account under its then-current credible/imminent threshold. Plaintiffs allege trained reviewers recommended referral and leadership overruled them.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Disputed contemporaneous trigger facts cannot be resolved solely by later policy.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Contemporaneous applicability/threshold is disputed; internal reviewer records are absent. Neither required non-activation nor a successful referral is established.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Civil plaintiffs allege ChatGPT reinforcement, planning assistance and memory effects on information and belief; specific exchanges are not published. Exact timing/order of the alleged outputs is unknown.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Product allegations and private conversations are distinct from authenticated model assistance.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: No authenticated inferential signal and consequential authority use is established.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The provider says the shooter used a second account missed by its repeat-policy-violator system. Its creation/use dates and matching signals are not public.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A miss does not by itself establish applicable coverage, activation or effect state.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: OpenAI confirms that its repeat-policy-violator system did not identify the second account before the perpetrator’s identity became public, but the public record does not show whether that account or its linking signals were within required monitoring coverage.

The reported miss and planned strengthening may indicate insufficient protective effect, but the public record does not show whether the applicable repeat-account control became operative on available matching signals or what effect it was designed to provide.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The later criminal complaint alleges human Discord communications about the attack beginning no later than August2025 and continuing until10February2026.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A separate human communication course does not become model output.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The criminal complaint alleges agreement to record/broadcast the attack and a livestream test in August2025.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Separate tests are reported within a continuing human support course.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The criminal complaint alleges another livestream test in January2026.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A later test is distinct from the earlier test and the attack-day feed.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The criminal complaint alleges25January financial support for an item used in the attack.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Alleged human financial assistance is distinct from AI assistance.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The criminal complaint describes alleged concealment discussions in August/December2025, including message deletion and streaming secrecy.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Human concealment is not attributed to ChatGPT.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The official account describes occasions of discouragement alongside assurances of non-referral and later assistance. These overlap the support course.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Ambivalence does not erase alleged consequential human acts.

clauses.source_paraphrase: On10February, two victims were killed at the residence before the school attack.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Home and school consequences are distinct sequential episodes.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The criminal complaint alleges livestream confirmation and vehicle-starting help after the home killings and before travel to school.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Attack-day human assistance has a separately supported order.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The school attack killed six victims; the shooter died by apparent suicide. Police responded and evacuated students/staff.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Whole-event deaths do not establish an AI-attributable fraction.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The11February police update corrected the casualty account: two serious injuries and approximately25 clinic assessments without discernible physical injury.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Assessment counts are not injury counts.

clauses.source_paraphrase: After the shooter’s name became public, OpenAI identified the second account.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Later discovery is distinct from earlier detection coverage.

clauses.source_paraphrase: OpenAI says it shared the second account with law enforcement upon discovery.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Reported disclosure is distinct from its unreported timing and completeness.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The26February letter says referral protocols had already been revised over prior months with expert input and more flexible criteria; the June account would now be referred. Exact revision dates are unknown.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A changed later threshold does not alone adjudicate earlier activation.

clauses.source_paraphrase: OpenAI committed to continued referral refinement with Canadian authorities and direct police contacts.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Future organisational commitments are not verified operational outcomes.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The provider committed to region-specific de-escalation support and local resources.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Planned support differs from demonstrated behaviour in this occurrence.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The provider committed to improved repeat-violator detection, periodic threshold review and stakeholder engagement.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Planned monitoring improvements do not establish earlier matching conditions or later efficacy.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The29April federal civil filing alleged negligence, facilitation and wrongful death.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A civil pleading is not a factual or liability judgment.

clauses.source_paraphrase: British Columbia retained counsel in July to explore legal action.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Legal planning and later filing are distinct responses.

clauses.source_paraphrase: British Columbia announced separate California proceedings in September concerning non-referral.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Legal planning and later filing are distinct responses.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The2October criminal complaint obtained a probable-cause finding on the alleged conspiracy.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Probable cause and arrest remain distinct from conviction.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The6October official announcement reported arrest on the conspiracy charge.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Probable cause and arrest remain distinct from conviction.

notes: G01: FC-083’s sufficient-protection/independent-downstream-mechanism exclusion overlaps the account-scoped positive finding. Preserve that finding; no claim that the ban prevented the attack.

Referral applicability remains disputed between provider and plaintiffs. Later policy cannot define the earlier trigger retroactively. FC-023 needs actual repeat-account coverage and matching signals; a missed account alone does not establish them. FC-046 needs a specific inference-to-authority conversion, not unproduced alleged chat assistance. Separate human Discord criminal allegations are not AI output.

failure_recognition.condition: A governance control is available and applicable.
failure_recognition.assessment: OpenAI describes an available violent-policy review and enforcement process.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined trigger or condition requiring activation occurs.
failure_recognition.assessment: Automated violent-activity detection provided the reported first-account trigger.

failure_recognition.condition: The control is not activated before the governed decision or action proceeds.
failure_recognition.assessment: Human review and a ban followed the detected activity.

success_recognition.condition: An available applicable control encounters its valid required trigger.
success_recognition.assessment: The provider reports detection of applicable violent-policy activity.

success_recognition.condition: The control is engaged and made operative with its activation decision and resulting state observable.
success_recognition.assessment: The first account was routed to reviewers and banned.

success_recognition.condition: Trigger, invocation and control-state evidence demonstrates activation for the affected action before the required governance point.
success_recognition.assessment: The reported detection-review-ban sequence establishes bounded activation before further use of that account.

exclusions.condition: The control activates but is bypassed downstream.
exclusions.assessment: The finding concerns first-account activation; later second-account coverage is separate.

exclusions.condition: It is unresolved whether the control is available or applicable.
exclusions.assessment: The provider explicitly identifies its available first-account process.

exclusions.condition: The triggering condition did not occur.
exclusions.assessment: Violent-policy activity was detected and reviewed.

failure_recognition.condition: A defined governance or protective control is applicable and validly becomes operative.
failure_recognition.assessment: The first-account enforcement control became operative.

failure_recognition.condition: The control has an identifiable protective purpose requiring a material effect such as prevention, blocking, containment, interruption, redirection, limitation, escalation, mitigation, or another protection-compatible outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: Its bounded purpose was restricting the detected account.

failure_recognition.condition: The actual control effect materially falls short of that required protective purpose, allowing the governed hazard to be delivered, continue, escape containment, or remain insufficiently mitigated.
failure_recognition.assessment: The account ban achieved that account-level restriction.

failure_recognition.condition: The shortfall is material in the evidenced hazard and protection context; where vulnerability, developmental status, capacity limitation, temporary or situational consent impairment, acute distress, cognitive asymmetry, or another heightened protection condition is relied on, that condition must itself be supported rather than presumed.
failure_recognition.assessment: The later attack and missed separate account do not establish that the banned account remained available.

success_recognition.condition: An applicable validly activated protective control faces its governed hazard.
success_recognition.assessment: The enforcement process faced the detected policy violation.

success_recognition.condition: The control produces a timely effect sufficient for its protective purpose and evidenced context, including any justified heightened protection.
success_recognition.assessment: The ban restricted that account’s continued use.

success_recognition.condition: Observed intervention and hazard outcome demonstrate the required containment or mitigation rather than activation alone.
success_recognition.assessment: The provider reports actual account restriction, beyond detection alone.

exclusions.condition: The applicable control does not become operative when a valid activation condition occurs; assess Required Control Activation.
The control becomes operative even though its valid activation or applicability conditions are not satisfied; assess Control Activation Validity.
exclusions.assessment: The provider identifies policy violations rather than an unwarranted ban.

exclusions.condition: The control becomes operative with a sufficient effect but its operative state is later lost, weakened, reset, or transformed before reaching the governed point; assess Control-State Preservation.
exclusions.assessment: No later reactivation of the first account is shown; the second account is a distinct pathway.

exclusions.condition: An operative governance signal fails to reach any capable endpoint or execution surface; assess the applicable governance-control reach class rather than treating non-delivery as inadequate control effect.
exclusions.assessment: The observed first-account effect was a ban, not a stalled notification.

exclusions.condition: The control produces the protective effect required by its defined purpose and the remaining harm arises through an independent downstream mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The bounded restriction occurred while the later attack and second-account activity were separate pathways.

exclusions.condition: The dispute is solely that policy should have required a stronger safeguard, without evidence of an applicable operational control or protective-effect obligation in the material context.
exclusions.assessment: The finding concerns an observed account control, not merely a proposed stronger policy.

exclusions.condition: Disability, neurodivergence, diagnosis, age-associated stereotype, or another personal characteristic is used by itself to presume incapacity, vulnerability, or diminished agency.
exclusions.assessment: No diagnosis or stereotype is used to infer incapacity.
